statements.t: “The investments we are making across the four pillars of our commercial strategy are working, and we expect another quarter of record revenue growth to close out the year.
Building on that commitment, the company announced on Oct. 8 that it plans to expand Starlink installation across its entire mainline fleet, bringing the technology to more than 1,000 aircraft.

By the end of 2026, the company expects to have achieved nearly $1 billion in annual run rate savings and more than $900 million in working capital improvements through its multiyear reengineering efforts.
For the full year, we expect to lead the network carriers in the spread between year-over-year unit revenue and CASM-ex growth.”
The company remains committed to reducing debt, lowering interest expense and achieving its target of 3.0x net debt 3 to EBITDAR, in line with BB credit metrics.
In the fourth quarter, the company expects continued revenue strength, with year-over-year revenue growth between 19.5% and 22.5%.

The information contained on, or that may be accessed through, the company’s website, social media channels or newsroom is not incorporated by reference into, and is not a part of, this document, and all website addresses in this document are intended to be inactive textual references only.

We may never realize the full value of our intangible or long-lived assets, causing us to record material impairment charges; the commercial relationships that we have with other companies, including any related equity investments, may not produce the returns or results we expect; our business is very dependent on the price and availability of aircraft fuel.

risks.t: downturns in economic conditions could adversely affect our business
we will need to obtain sufficient financing or other capital to operate successfully
if our financial condition worsens, provisions in our credit card processing and other commercial agreements may adversely affect our liquidity
the airline industry is intensely competitive and dynamic
union disputes, employee strikes and other labor-related disruptions may adversely affect our operations and financial performance
any damage to our reputation or brand image could adversely affect our business or financial results
risks of losses and adverse publicity from any public incidents involving our company, people or brand
we may be a party to litigation in the normal course of business or otherwise, which could affect our financial position and liquidity
evolving data privacy requirements could increase our costs, and any significant cybersecurity incident
